messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT question formatting
parts:
There's a few unofficial files that I use for testing mirtCAT's GUI that test these types of outputs, listed here: https://github.com/philchalmers/mirtCAT/tree/master/tests/GUI-tests Line 169 and down of the GUI-tests.R file is probably what you are looking for if you want complete customization on the HTML end. 

At some point I really should create a more involved manual for generating and working with mirtCAT, particularly the GUI portion with screenshots and such, but it's somewhat lower on my priority list at the moment. 

Phil
